name: Assetto Corsa Competizione
description: Assetto Corsa Competizione dedicated server (Steam app 1430110). The download needs a Steam account that owns Assetto Corsa Competizione: set it in Settings > Steam or on the game Steam tab.

customPorts.description: Connections (TCP, configuration.json tcpPort) and the status check

editor.label: Listed in the public lobby
editor.description: Off: a private server, joined through the direct IP only.

editor.label: LAN discovery
editor.description: Answers LAN discovery requests. Off by default: the discovery port is fixed by the game, so two servers on one host would clash.

editor.label: Spectator password
editor.description: Must differ from the join password. No double quotes or backslashes.

editor.label: Track medals required
editor.description: Medals the driver needs on this track (0 to 3).

editor.label: Safety rating required
editor.description: -1 = no requirement.

editor.label: Racecraft rating required
editor.description: -1 = no requirement.

editor.label: Lock the race
editor.description: No new drivers can join once the race session has started.

editor.label: Automatic disqualification
editor.description: Off: the server gives stop-and-go penalties instead, for an admin to review.

editor.label: Write session results
editor.description: Writes a results file to server/results after each session.

editor.label: Write the entry list
editor.description: Writes the drivers of the qualifying session to server/cfg as an entry list.

editor.label: Track
editor.description: DLC tracks need the DLC on the drivers' side only.

editor.description: At least 30.

script.name: Save config files as UTF-16
script.description: Before each start, rewrites every server/cfg/*.json that is not UTF-16 LE with a BOM: accServer ignores other encodings and replaces the file with defaults. Never follows links.

script.name: ACC status
script.description: Online when accServer listens on its TCP port. ACC has no query protocol; nothing connects to the game.
